trigger_cases.prompt: Turn this Zoom transcript into structured meeting notes.
Here is an Otter.ai transcription of our sprint planning, extract action items and decisions.
Summarize this postmortem meeting using 5 Whys and codified principles.
Convert this 1:1 voice memo into an 80/20 MVN note.
Format this executive readout transcript using McKinsey SCQA and STE language rules.
Classify these strategic decisions into Type 1 and Type 2 Amazon narrative memos.
Write a python script to calculate Fibonacci numbers.
Build a React component for a date picker.
Configure our Terraform AWS VPC module.
Optimize SQL queries on postgres table.

binary_cases.prompt: Extract action items from this meeting transcript.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Enforces exactly one directly responsible individual (DRI) per action item with hard deadlines.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Actions: @Sarah is DRI to finalize the API schema by 2026-09-15. @Dave is DRI to run load tests by 2026-09-18.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Actions: @Team will look into the API schema and someone on the team will run load tests with TBD deadline.

binary_cases.prompt: Summarize this steering committee transcript for executive stakeholders.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Formats executive meeting synthesis according to Minto Pyramid SCQA structure.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Situation: Mobile MAU grew 20%. Complication: Latency degraded 40% in EMEA. Question: Should we deploy edge caches in Frankfurt? Answer: Yes, deploy Cloudflare edge workers immediately.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Here is the chronological dialogue: Alice said then Bob replied about some latency issues in Europe.

binary_cases.prompt: Document this strategic product review transcript.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Explicitly classifies strategic decisions as Type 1 (irreversible) or Type 2 (reversible) and captures dissent.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Decision: Migrate payment provider (Type 1 Irreversible). Dissent: Dan raised migration downtime risks but agreed under Disagree and Commit. Owner: @Dan.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Unclassified decision without ownership made during the meeting.

binary_cases.prompt: Create an issue-log and retro notes from this incident triage transcript.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Conducts reality gap analysis, 5 Whys root cause inquiry, and establishes a codified principle.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Reality Gap: What Happened vs Expected: Deployment failed. Root Cause 5 Whys: Missing automated linting gate in CI. Principle: Never merge PRs without automated contract tests.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Blame individual without fixing system for the outage.

binary_cases.prompt: Give me a quick 80/20 summary of this 15-minute sync.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Synthesizes rapid 1:1 or standup meetings into the 80/20 Minimum Viable Note (The 1 Thing, Bottleneck, 2-3 Actions).
binary_cases.pass_fixture: The 1 Thing: Close enterprise deal with Acme Corp. Bottleneck: Legal redlines on indemnity. Actions: 1. @Lisa to approve updated clause by 2026-09-02.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Lengthy 10 page meeting minutes and chronological transcript of our full morning discussion.

binary_cases.prompt: Format meeting action items using ASD-STE100 technical English rules.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Enforces ASD-STE100 technical language rules with imperative verbs, sentence length limits, and deterministic connectors (because, after, before).
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Actions: @Dave: Deploy Redis replica because queries timed out. Complete verification by 2026-09-10.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Actions: Dave will look into deploying Redis in order to fix queries since the system was slow prior to Friday.

binary_cases.prompt: Compress raw transcript notes into high-density decision records.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Eliminates conversational filler and throat-clearing while preserving exact technical metrics and dates.
must_not: let me know if you have questions
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Decision: Scale checkout API to handle 450ms p95 latency. DRI: @Dan to merge PR by 2026-09-08.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Um thanks for joining happy monday everyone, basically what I think we should do is scale the API. Let me know if you have questions.
